2.2 Secondary Objectives
Data Privacy — Every stage of the pipeline (parsing, OCR, embedding, vector search, generation) executes inside the organization's own network boundary. Nothing is architecturally capable of leaving, rather than merely policy-forbidden from leaving.
Cost Optimization — Replace per-token cloud billing with a fixed infrastructure cost. The economics flip from "cost scales with usage" to "cost is provisioned once, usage is free at the margin."
Enterprise Search — Replace keyword matching (which requires the user to guess the exact words in the source document) with semantic search, where a question like "what did we spend on logistics last quarter" can retrieve a passage titled "Q3 Freight & Distribution Costs" even though no words match literally. 1. Problem Statement
1.1 Current Challenges
SMEs generate large volumes of business data daily, spread across PDFs, Excel spreadsheets, Word documents, PowerPoint decks, scanned invoices, images, emails, and relational databases. As volume grows, locating a specific fact becomes disproportionately harder than the data itself growing — search is manual, employee time is spent re-finding rather than using information, and results are inconsistent across people.
Cloud AI assistants (ChatGPT, Copilot) solve the retrieval-and-synthesis problem but introduce a new one:
Sensitive company data must transit to a third-party service to be processed.
